Container.Name: vyzn
Container.Overview: VYZN is a self-hosted media server: scans a folder of movies/TV for video files, indexes them with TMDB metadata (full Show -> Season -> Episode hierarchy for TV), and serves them as HLS streams to a browser or the companion Android TV app. Includes profiles with content-rating gating, Continue Watching, genre shelves, hardware (VAAPI) transcoding, optional Seerr-backed recommendations/requests, and optional Tailscale for remote access — all configurable after install from Control Center > Settings in the app itself, no need to edit this template again.
Container.Description: VYZN is a self-hosted media server: scans a folder of movies/TV for video files, indexes them with TMDB metadata, and serves them as HLS streams to a browser or the companion Android TV app.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI / stream server listens on

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Your movies/TV folder(s) — read-only, VYZN never writes here

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and logs — this is what to back up

Config.Name: Transcode Cache
Config.Description: Scratch space for HLS transcoding — safe to clear, not a backup target

Config.Name: Theme Music
Config.Description: Optional: drop a show's theme song in here as {tmdb_id}.mp3 and it plays on the Show Detail page

Config.Name: GPU (QuickSync)
Config.Description: Intel iGPU passthrough for hardware transcoding — remove this device if your box has no Intel iGPU

Config.Name: Tailscale TUN
Config.Description: Lets the container create its own VPN network interface for the optional Tailscale remote-access feature

Config.Name: Hardware Transcoding
Config.Description: true to use the Intel iGPU (VAAPI) for HLS encoding; false falls back to CPU (libx264)

Config.Name: Media Dir (internal)
Config.Description: Must match the Media Library path's container target above

Config.Name: Data Dir (internal)
Config.Description: Must match the App Data path's container target above

Config.Name: Transcode Dir (internal)
Config.Description: Must match the Transcode Cache path's container target above

Config.Name: VAAPI Driver
Config.Description: iHD for Broadwell (2015+) and newer Intel iGPUs; i965 for older ones

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional here — can also be set from Control Center > Settings after install. v3 key from themoviedb.org/settings/api

Config.Name: Seerr URL
Config.Description: Optional — enables recommendations/requests via a Jellyseerr/Overseerr instance. e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5055

Config.Name: Seerr API Key
Config.Description: Optional — from Jellyseerr/Overseerr Settings > General > API Key
